name: Piedra del Fraile
why: Up the forested valley of the Río Eléctrico to a refuge under a huge boulder, with the north face of Fitz Roy and the Marconi glacier ahead.
book: Private land: small fee at the refuge. Bus or taxi from El Chaltén to the Río Eléctrico bridge (17 km).

points.name: Río Eléctrico bridge
points.note: The bridge on the road north of El Chaltén.

points.name: Piedra del Fraile
points.note: A refuge beside a giant boulder in the forest.
